premises: Mechanical alloying can incorporate ~2 vol% Y2O3 nanoparticles into a CoCrFeNi HEA with a uniform, nanoscale dispersion.
A uniform dispersion of Y2O3 nanoparticles pins grain boundaries and inhibits dislocation motion at elevated temperatures.
Grain boundary pinning and dislocation inhibition mitigate grain growth and creep deformation at ~700°C.
Y2O3 nanoparticles enhance oxidation resistance in CoCrFeNi-based HEAs at ~700°C.
The reinforced alloy will show higher tensile strength, lower creep rates, and better oxidation resistance than the unreinforced alloy at 700°C.
